title: The White Industries Desert Sage Cerakote Collection Includes Cranks, Hubs, Headsets and More
content:
White Industries is proud to announce the launch of its Limited Edition Desert Sage Cerakote Collection, an exclusive finish available on a selection of the brand’s precision-machined components…

Inspired by the muted tones of the desert, Desert Sage combines understated style with the exceptional durability of Cerakote ceramic coating—creating a finish that’s as capable as the rides it was designed for. Available for a limited time only, the Desert Sage Collection lets riders build a truly distinctive bike with the precision, craftsmanship, and reliability that have defined White Industries for almost 50 years.

Unlike traditional anodizing, Cerakote is a premium ceramic-based coating known for its outstanding resistance to scratches, corrosion, chemicals, and everyday wear. The finish provides a refined matte appearance while helping components maintain their appearance through years of riding. Each component begins as a precision-machined White Industries product manufactured in the company’s Petaluma, California facility. After machining and finishing, products receive their Desert Sage Cerakote coating before final engraving, assembly, and inspection.

The collection includes a variety of White Industries’ most popular components, including:

  • Hubs- CLD and CLD+ Boost Front Hubs: $288.75 Rear Hubs: $554.50
  • Cranks- G30 and M30 at $505.00
  • Headsets- 34/34mm, 34/44mm and 44/44mm at $225.00
  • BSA Bottom Brackets- 29mm and 30mm at $191.00
  • Seat Collars- 30mm, 35mm, 36mm- at $84.00
  • Top Cap- at $29.75

Like every White Industries component, the Desert Sage Collection is designed for riders who value long-term performance, serviceability, and American manufacturing.

See more at White Industries.
